name: 玫粉渐变罐装睡眠唇膜款
description: 小罐睡眠唇膜：白底主图、质地旋峰、双栏唇部对照与六罐阵列

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, comparison panels and spec screens; flat rose-pink field #F7C3C8 and pale petal panel #FAEFF0 for benefit, texture and variant screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft beauty lightbox lighting, front key with fill card, skimming or sweeping accent light only where texture must read, gentle contact shadows, never harsh, never flat flash
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale laminate #EFEDEE, warm grey backdrop #E9E4E2 and glossy petal acrylic sheet #FAEFF0
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one uppercase headline weight plus one light subline weight, all rendered copy reduced to placeholder slots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rings and pill frames in accent #E8465B, no filled pictograms, no badge artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: the jar stays upright with the same straight-on or slight 3/4 read across screens; the texture sweep always arcs away from the label face and never covers it; hands and lips stay cropped so no identity reads
noDrift: no filled award badges or star ratings
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium soft-pink lip care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white background #FFFFFF, rose-pink field #F7C3C8, one berry-red accent #E8465B and charcoal text #38343A; bright soft beauty lightbox lighting with a front key, fill card and skimming or sweeping texture accent, always with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one uppercase headline weight and one light subline weight; thin single-weight line rings and pill frames only, no filled pictograms and no badge artwork; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle and scale; hands and lip crops never reveal identity; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净罐身剪影与一抹质地交代膏体形态。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, jar upright and centred, full height visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one sculpted sweep of the product's own texture arcing behind the jar
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond clean even margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The jar standing upright and centred with the lid on, photographed straight-on at eye level so the full height reads and nothing is clipped; one sculpted sweep of the product's own texture arcs behind it at the upper left. Bright even high-key beauty lighting, front key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace beyond clean even margins. 4K commercial beauty ecommerce quality. Negative: no award badge or star rating, no brand wordmark, no hands, no in-image text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated jar, no texture blob fused onto the label face, no floating product without a contact shadow, no tinted or gradient background.

shots.intent: 一秒传达核心利益，用刮棒挑起的膏体旋峰做主视觉主张。
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward along the lifted texture peak
shots.lighting: soft beauty box light with a skimming accent from the left reading the gloss peaks, gentle contact shadow at the wand base
shots.props: one slim pale spatula wand lifting a soft-peaked swirl above the open jar
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space down the left third for the copy column
shots.textZone: left third column, one headline slot over one subline slot
shots.promptTemplate: Benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A slim pale spatula wand lifts a soft-peaked swirl of the product's own texture above the open jar, photographed from a very low angle looking upward along the swirl so it towers through the right half of the frame. Soft beauty box light with a skimming accent from the left that reads the gloss peaks, gentle contact shadow at the wand base. Background flat rose-pink field #F7C3C8. The wand and jar together occupy 50-60% of the frame, with generous clean negative space down the left third reserved for a copy column holding only the placeholders 「{selling_point_1}」 as the headline and 「{callout_1}」 beneath it in charcoal #38343A. Negative: no invented duration, percentage or clinical wording, no certification seal, no source brand wordmark, no face, no extra props, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking or painted-on texture, no dense body copy.

shots.intent: 放大起皮干渴的唇部状态，制造代入感并引出护理动作。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at lip level, straight-on, crop ending below the nose
shots.lighting: deliberately flat slightly harsh upper-left key with a low sweep of skimming light exaggerating every dry flake, weak fill, muted contrast
shots.background: clean neutral warm-grey backdrop #E9E4E2 at the frame edges
shots.whitespace: none, the crop is intentionally tight
shots.promptTemplate: Pain-point screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro of bare lips only, photographed straight-on at lip level with the crop ending below the nose so no identity can read; the surface looks tight, matte and flaking. Deliberately flat, slightly harsh upper-left key with a low sweep of skimming light that exaggerates every dry flake, weak fill, muted contrast. Clean neutral warm-grey backdrop #E9E4E2 at the frame edges. The lips fill 55-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace because the crop is intentionally tight. Negative: no identifiable face, eyes or person, no wounds, lesions or gore, no product jar in frame, no before or after wording, no fabricated statistic, no watermark, no fake logo, no glossy retouched skin, no blurry subject.

shots.intent: 用同机位同光的六格唇部状态矩阵呈现差异，替代原始前后主张。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level matched grid, identical crop and distance in every cell
shots.lighting: same soft front key with a gentle gloss highlight on both columns, identical exposure left to right
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with thin hairline dividers in light grey #E9E4E2
shots.whitespace: hairline dividers only, no open outer margins
shots.textZone: two blank rounded pill frames at the lower left and lower right, no words rendered
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen showing the use of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A matched grid of six lip close-ups in three rows and two columns, every panel photographed straight-on at eye level with identical crop, distance and lighting so only the surface state differs: the left column reads matte and flaking, the right column reads coated and glossy. Same soft front key with a gentle gloss highlight on both columns, seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, thin hairline dividers in light grey #E9E4E2. Each panel's lips fill 55-60% of its own cell, with two blank rounded pill frames left empty at the lower left and lower right and no words rendered inside them. Negative: no before or after wording, no unverifiable result claims, no retouched or painted-on shine, no identifiable faces, no competitor product or name, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched crop or light between the two columns, no fused or duplicated lip shapes.

shots.intent: 以手持实物的近人尺度场景建立代入，并把数据栏留成空位。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at eye level, crop cutting above the mouth
shots.lighting: soft diffused beauty lightbox from the front-left with a low-contrast fill, delicate contact shadow under the hand
shots.props: one relaxed hand cradling the small jar at the jawline of a generic adult model
shots.whitespace: generous clean space down the left third
shots.textZone: left third, three stacked headline blocks over three empty indicator bars, no numbers rendered
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A relaxed hand cradles the small jar at the jawline of a generic adult model, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle at eye level with the crop cutting above the mouth so nothing identifies the person; skin keeps natural texture and visible pores. Soft diffused beauty lightbox from the front-left with a low-contrast fill, delicate contact shadow under the hand. Background matte pale laminate panel #EFEDEE. The hand and jar occupy 40-50% of the frame on the right, with generous clean space down the left third for three stacked headline blocks and three empty indicator bars, no numbers or words rendered. Negative: no percentages, hours or year claims, no testimonial or clinical wording, no identifiable eyes or face, no deformed or extra fingers, no long manicure nails, no watermark, no fake logo, no over-smoothed plastic skin.

shots.intent: 展示真实上唇动作与膏体铺展方式，让用户预演使用步骤。
shots.camera: straight-on tight crop of the lower face from nose to chin, eyes outside the frame
shots.lighting: soft even beauty light from the front with a bright specular ribbon along the freshly coated surface, gentle shadow under the chin
shots.props: one slim spatula wand laying a glossy layer across the lips, fingertips at the frame edge
shots.whitespace: clean open space across the upper left
shots.textZone: upper left headline slot, left empty with no words rendered
shots.promptTemplate: Usage scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A tight straight-on crop of a generic model's lower face from nose to chin, eyes outside the frame, with a slim spatula wand laying a glossy layer across the lips so the formula reads as the product's own texture. Soft even beauty light from the front with a bright specular ribbon along the freshly coated surface, gentle shadow under the chin. Background pale petal panel #FAEFF0. The mouth and wand occupy 40-50% of the frame with clean open space across the upper left for one short headline slot, no words rendered. Negative: no identifiable eyes or full face, no deformed fingers, no sticky stringy product, no whitening or medical claims, no source brand wordmark, no watermark, no fake logo, no over-retouched skin, no wand occluding the label face.

shots.intent: 开盖与闭盖双件同框，证明内料形态并留出参数行空位。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at two arranged units
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light from the upper left, controlled gloss highlights on the inner surface, soft contact shadows under both units
shots.props: one closed upright unit lower right and one tipped unit showing the open well of texture
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the left half
shots.textZone: left half, three stacked label slots on thin grey rules
shots.promptTemplate: Detail screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two units arranged on the counter, one closed and upright in the lower right and the other tipped to show the open well of texture inside, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so both the lid top and the inner surface read clearly. Bright soft studio light from the upper left, controlled gloss highlights on the texture, soft contact shadows under both units. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The two units occupy 50-60% of the frame overall, with generous negative space across the left half reserved for three stacked label slots holding only the placeholders 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in charcoal #38343A over thin grey rules. Negative: no ingredient names, no percentages or purity claims, no dense body copy, no watermark, no fake logo, no spilled product outside the jar, no duplicated or fused lids, no unit without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 用微距证明膏体状态，线描圆环留作空标签位。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: sweeping soft key from the upper right leaving a long glossy highlight and one restrained shadow at the lower edge
shots.props: one wide smear of the product's own texture filling the right two thirds
shots.whitespace: minimal negative space, the smear is the subject
shots.textZone: two thin-line circle outlines stacked at the left, kept empty as label rings
shots.promptTemplate: Texture macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro of a single wide smear of the product's own texture, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle so the ridges and the slow drip of the edge fill the right two thirds of the frame, shallow depth of field with the leading ridge sharp. A sweeping soft key from the upper right leaves a long glossy highlight and one restrained shadow at the lower edge. Background pale petal acrylic sheet #FAEFF0. The smear fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal negative space, and two thin-line circle outlines in accent #E8465B are stacked at the left, kept empty as label rings. Negative: no sticky strings or flyaway hairs in the smear, no grainy or plastic-looking formula, no words inside the rings, no invented finish claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no blurry subject, no duplicated smear.

shots.intent: 3x2 阵列给出可选规格位，色名与香型全部留成空白胶囊。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level grid of six upright units, identical scale in every cell
shots.lighting: even soft studio light from the front, matched contact shadows under all six bases
shots.props: six matched units each with one small texture sweep at its lower left
shots.whitespace: one blank pill under each unit, even outer margins
shots.textZone: top headline band plus six blank pill labels, all kept empty
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Six identical units arranged in two rows of three, each upright and each with its own small texture sweep at the lower left, photographed straight-on at eye level with one consistent light and scale across all six. Even soft studio light from the front, matched contact shadows. Background flat rose-pink field #F7C3C8. The six units fill 70-80% of the frame overall, with one blank rounded pill under each unit and a headline band across the top, all left empty with no words rendered. Negative: no color or scent names, no invented variant count claim, no mismatched lighting or scale between units, no duplicated or fused jars, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background, no clipped edge units.

shots.intent: 把源图的奖项章结构留成两个空线描印章框，降风险而不背书。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, straight-on eye-level, jar upright
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light with a fill card, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.props: one texture sweep behind the jar; two thin-line seal rings held empty
shots.whitespace: generous clear space at the upper right for the two empty rings
shots.textZone: upper right, two empty thin-line seal rings with no words
shots.promptTemplate: Trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The jar standing upright at a slight 3/4 hero angle with a single texture sweep arcing behind it, photographed straight-on at eye level, and two empty seal frames kept as plain thin-line rings at the upper right with no badge artwork inside them. Even high-key studio light with a fill card, soft contact shadow under the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous clear space at the upper right for the two empty rings. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, magazine names, years or test data; no filled badge artwork, no star rating, no review wording, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no extra props, no tinted background.

shots.intent: 双层层板家族陈列收口，只留一行标题与一枚空白按钮框。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level from just below the shelf edge so both tiers read
shots.lighting: soft even beauty light with a gentle rim along the lids, light contact shadows on each shelf
shots.background: deeper rose shelving #F3B9C0 over a pale petal panel #FAEFF0
shots.props: the hero jar forward at the centre with a few sibling units standing loosely behind on two tiers
shots.whitespace: clean open space across the top band
shots.textZone: top headline band plus one blank rounded button frame, no words rendered
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The jar placed forward at the centre of a two-tier rose shelf with a few sibling units standing loosely behind it, photographed straight-on at eye level from just below the shelf edge so both tiers read as one set. Soft even beauty light with a gentle rim along the lids, light contact shadows landing on each shelf. Background deeper rose shelving #F3B9C0 over a pale petal panel #FAEFF0. The shelf group occupies 55-60% of the frame overall with clean open space across the top band for one short headline slot and one blank rounded button frame, no words rendered. Negative: no invented discount, price, rank or market-share claim, no years or statistics, no more than five units, no duplicated or fused products, no watermark, no fake logo, no clipped shelf edges, no chaotic props.

provenance.notes: 11 张源图逐图事实：001 白底小罐正面加一抹摊开质地；002 同构图右上角叠一枚奖项章；003 三行两列唇部特写对照（左栏哑光起皮、右栏涂后发亮，四角带角标字样，仅露唇部无身份）；004 粉底上一支小刮棒挑起旋峰膏体，左侧三行大字卖点加一枚圆章；005 白底四件唇部系列横排，下方为五行参数对照表；006 白底开盖与闭盖双件斜置，左侧三行成分文字；007 浅灰底手持小罐贴下颌，左侧三行百分比数据加脚注；008 浅色底刮棒薄涂上唇，左侧两段用法文字；009 浅色底膏体摊开微距加两个线描圆圈标签；010 粉底 3x2 六罐阵列，各带一抹质地与色名胶囊；011 粉橘双层层板全系列陈列加顶部一行品牌成就主张。品类判定依据：图中为矮罐膏体唇部护理品，无着色、以唇部滋润状态与膏体质地售卖，故归「护肤个护/面部护理」而非「美妆彩妆/唇部」，源站类目仅作检索线索。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列名、奖项与刊物徽章、星级与评论、百分比与时长等检测数据、成分与功效主张、香型与色名、图内原文案与脚注，以及模特身份（一律只保留唇部或鼻下裁切）；参数表与印章改为空白表格行、空指示条、空印章框与空白按钮框，卖点仅以占位符出现。
